Definition: Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Eshtemoa = "I will make myself heard" Eshtemoh = "I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft"; 1) a Levitical city in Judah; 2) a man of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
